trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. It is the last trophy you will get: finish the story, reach 100% completion, and clean up everything else, and the platinum is yours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, and the trophy pops when you finish it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it is a moment late.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep playing the story; the chapter trophy pops as you finish it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. While you are here, do Race Against Yago the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive and counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks bank vaults — do it when it appears.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission — you cannot go back and redo it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Finishing it also unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, which opens up the partner trophies.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the heist is done.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story trophy — it pops as you play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story trophy — it pops as you play.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy — it pops as you play.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy — it pops as you play.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist — work you did earlier already counts. It is the hardest trophy and the longest grind, around 200 hours for the whole platinum. You only need selected portions of most activities (for example 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 18 card sets), not everything.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going to 300, since 100% completion needs 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. Sample one of everything — a race, a round at the shooting range, a drone race, fishing, an arcade game, and the rest — and it pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them, so visit both and clear every challenge at gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Win at least one race at each location; there are 42 drone time trials across them in total.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, air and water. Repeating the same race does not add to the total.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and out-fish him — it is a straight contest, so bring your best rod and bait.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts — pick one, play it through, and it pops.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, and it stays available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears: it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and its strand counts.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only, and it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation is the one you can miss: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after Down to Earth is the usual time) — she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in total; 100% completion needs 15 of them, but this trophy only needs 3, so finish any three sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to scan landmarks and locations as you explore — 100 scans is the trophy, and 100% completion also wants 100 WAiNK locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges. 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50 — many complete on their own while you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bank vaults give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this too. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks roam the roads — hit one, grab the cash, and get clear of the heat. It pops once you are out of the red heat zone, not while you are still being chased.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail through every region until the whole map is uncovered — 52 areas in total. The map fills in as you go, so cover the coastline, the swamps, the islands and the cities.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way as you work through them.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description is the only hint — enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. It may pop while you play normally. We will add the method once it is confirmed, so do not trust unverified claims about it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description is the only hint — smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. It may pop while you play normally. We will add the method once it is confirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Keep training both characters until each one's Strength is maxed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just keep playing and it will come. This 500-action count is single-sourced (GTABase), so treat it as unconfirmed until more guides agree.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — Second time's the charm — is the only hint. It may pop while you play normally. We will add the method once it is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — What the hell just happened? — is the only hint. It may pop while you play normally. We will add the method once it is confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The description is Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by, and the precise method is still being confirmed. Do not rely on unverified methods for this one.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The $100,000 is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, and the rest — so it adds up as you play.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties. Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
